Unique Research · Ranking · December 23, 2024

Board title: November 2024 AI Industry Rankings | Company Boards
Publisher: Unique Research · Date: December 23, 2024
Sources: diversified hybrid · Compiled by: Unique Research
Window: November 1–30, 2024

Board set

  • Global AI company unicorns TOP100
  • Global AI company revenue TOP100
  • Global AI company valuation-growth TOP100
  • China AI company attention TOP50
  • China AI product coverage TOP100
  • China listed AI company attention TOP10
  • China listed-company AI product coverage TOP50

[Full ranked tables live in CN charts — attach images.json on import]

01. Global AI company boards

1.1 Unicorns TOP100. From Unique Research’s independent industry work and ongoing tracking of thousands of AI companies and ~10k products: unlisted AI companies with latest post-money valuation ≥ $1B, ranked by that valuation.

1.2 Revenue TOP100. Ranked by estimated annual revenue for the month’s snapshot.

1.3 Valuation-growth TOP100. Ranked by valuation growth rate.

02. China AI company boards

2.1 Attention TOP50. China AI companies ranked by aggregate visit duration across their AI products.

2.2 Product coverage TOP100. China AI products ranked by cumulative WEB + APP monthly active users.

03. China listed-company boards

3.1 Listed attention TOP10. Listed China AI companies by aggregate product visit duration.

3.2 Listed product coverage TOP50. AI products under listed China companies by cumulative WEB + APP MAU.

04. Research notes

Hybrid sources + Unique Research algorithms; label/classify in-house. Scope: PC/tablet/phone via website and APP only — not plugins, desktop software, mini-programs, Discord/third-party apps, or local open-source runs. Universe: AI products with >10k monthly visits; focus global / China / outbound Top 30/50/100.

Geography: overseas / domestic / outbound. Function: AI-native / AI-feature / AI-ecosystem. Metrics: visits, UV, visit duration; downloads, sessions, active users, duration time — definitions as in prior ranking packages.

Cite 【Data source: Unique Research】; charts 【Data source: Unique Research; chart: Unique Research】. Independent analysis; not investment advice. Affiliations may exist where legally permitted.

Author / editor: Delta

— END —
